proposals.expected_failure_mode: H compartment may be weakly identifiable in a short single-season series; can yield parameter tradeoffs (e.g., I→H rate vs H duration) and over-smoothing or phase shifts if admissions timing is not well captured.
proposals.rationale: Primary semantic anchor: target is weekly hospitalization rate, so directly observing H avoids relying on an inferred I-to-hospitalization lag. Keeps within allowed families and provides a robustness benchmark against delayed_I specs.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: If hospitalization dynamics vary over time or differ from a fixed lagged-I proxy, forecasts can mis-time peaks or mis-estimate amplitude; delay may be unstable across splits.
proposals.rationale: Low-complexity anchor with a plausible 2-week lag from infections to admissions; aligns with prior best delay and prioritizes rolling robustness by avoiding waning-immunity and hospitalization compartments.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: If true lag is longer, forecasts may lead the observed hospitalization peak and inflate early-season rates; delay choice can be unstable and window-dependent.
proposals.rationale: Tight delay-grid exploration for robustness: a shorter lag can reduce sensitivity to split timing and may better match faster admission pathways in pediatric populations while keeping structure parsimonious.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: Higher risk of split-specific overfit and degraded rolling performance; may lag peaks excessively and under-react to rapid changes.
proposals.rationale: Completes the constrained delay search (1–3 weeks) to assess stability; provides a controlled comparison to detect overfit/sensitivity previously noted for longer delays.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: Added waning-immunity flexibility can be weakly identified and may absorb noise, causing instability across rolling splits or unrealistic rebound dynamics.
proposals.rationale: Include only one waning-immunity variant as a challenger to the SEIR anchor at the previously best delay; tests whether SEIRS improves rolling stability without expanding delay degrees of freedom.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: Observation mixture can be non-identifiable (I vs H contributions) and may blur timing, leading to biased peak height or overly persistent tails.
proposals.rationale: Alternative hospitalization-aligned mapping that can be more robust if admissions reflect a mixture of current infectious burden and hospitalized census/flow; stays within SEIHR while offering a second direct-hospitalization benchmark.
